description: Fires when a move creates a non-trivial threat (see_cp >= MIN_THREAT_SEE_CP) and no higher-priority tactic above it caught it. Authored by content team (Mohit + Parth) — no Python edits.

fact_glossary.played_san: SAN of the move that was just played (e.g. 'Na5', 'Bxc4')
fact_glossary.target_piece_type: Type of the threatened piece — one of: pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king
fact_glossary.target_square: Square the threatened piece sits on (e.g. 'c4', 'h8')
